rules.title: Los Angeles Rent Stabilization Ordinance - Annual Rent Increase Cap
rules.quote: Rent may be increased once every 12 months by the allowable rent increase percentage (click here to view the allowable rent increase PDF). Effective February 2, 2026, the landlord can no longer include an additional percentage increase for utilities.
rules.summary: Landlords may increase rent once every 12 months by an allowable percentage, and as of February 2, 2026, cannot add an additional percentage for utilities.
rules.key_value: Annual allowable percentage (specific formula not stated in document)
rules.coverage_text: Generally, the RSO applies to rental properties that were first built on or before October 1, 1978
rules.exemption_note: Condominiums and townhomes have rent not regulated for tenancies that commenced after December 31, 1995

rules.title: Los Angeles RSO - Rent Increase Moratorium (March 2020 - January 2024)
rules.quote: Effective March 30, 2020, through January 31, 2024, rent increases are prohibited for rental units subject to the Rent Stabilization Ordinance (RSO).
rules.summary: Rent increases were prohibited for RSO units from March 30, 2020 through January 31, 2024.
rules.effective_date_evidence: Effective March 30, 2020, through January 31, 2024, rent increases are prohibited for rental units subject to the Rent Stabilization Ordinance (RSO).
rules.coverage_text: Generally, the RSO applies to rental properties that were first built on or before October 1, 1978

rules.title: Los Angeles RSO - Just Cause Eviction Requirements
rules.quote: All notices to terminate a tenancy for all rental units subject to City's Rent Stabilization Ordinance (RSO) must be filed with the Los Angeles Housing Department (LAHD) within three (3) business days of service on the tenant per Los Angeles Municipal Code 151.09.C.9 & 165.05.B.5.
rules.summary: Landlords must file all eviction notices with LAHD within three business days of serving them on the tenant.
rules.coverage_text: Generally, the RSO applies to rental properties that were first built on or before October 1, 1978

rules.title: Los Angeles RSO - Relocation Assistance for No-Fault Evictions
rules.quote: No-fault evictions require the payment of relocation assistance.
rules.summary: Landlords must pay relocation assistance to tenants when evicting them for no-fault reasons.
rules.coverage_text: Generally, the RSO applies to rental properties that were first built on or before October 1, 1978

rules.title: Los Angeles RSO - Notice of Right to Counsel
rules.quote: Beginning August 20, 2025, landlords must post the Notice of Right to Counsel and provide it to the tenant at the start of the tenancy. The Notice must also be attached to a copy of any eviction notice or termination of a rental subsidy.
rules.summary: Starting August 20, 2025, landlords must post and provide tenants with a Notice of Right to Counsel at move-in and attach it to any eviction notice.
rules.effective_date_evidence: Beginning August 20, 2025, landlords must post the Notice of Right to Counsel and provide it to the tenant at the start of the tenancy.
rules.coverage_text: Generally, the RSO applies to rental properties that were first built on or before October 1, 1978

rules.title: Los Angeles RSO - Interest Payments on Security Deposits
rules.summary: The RSO covers interest payments on security deposits for covered rental units.
rules.coverage_text: Generally, the RSO applies to rental properties that were first built on or before October 1, 1978
